children: US oncology drugmaker's Q3 revenue rose, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted net income for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company repurchased $402 mln in shares during the quarter under stock buyback program
Exelixis maintains 2026 total revenue guidance at $2.5 bln to $2.55 bln
Company expects 2026 net product revenues of $2.3 bln to $2.35 bln
Exelixis lowers 2026 effective tax rate guidance to 16%-18% from 21%-23%
CABOZANTINIB SALES - Co said higher US net product revenue was driven by increased sales volume and higher average net selling price

COLLABORATION REVENUE DECLINE - Co said lower collaboration revenue reflected decreased milestone-related revenue and lower development cost reimbursements, partly offset by higher royalties from partner sales outside the U.S.
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Co said research and development and selling, general and administrative expenses rose due to increased personnel, clinical trial costs, marketing, and legal fees
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 11 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Exelixis Inc is $54.00, about 18.5% below its October 28 closing price of $66.28
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
